Package hadur2.core.gun

package hadur2.core.gun
The duel's gun: two KNN guns, the virtual guns that rate them, and the choice between them.
  • GunController: owns each opponent's gun views, picks the gun that aims (the opening book's choice from the first wave, ADAPT-1, until the live ratings differ beyond their margin, DIAL-1), scores the virtual guns, logs broken waves, replays profile seeds (ADAPT-3) and sets 1.20's bullet power.
  • MainGun: a displacement-vector gun over one large view, with a kernel density over its neighbours' angles; the only gun used in melee.
  • AntiSurferGun: four small, fast-forgetting views pooled into one guess-factor density, for opponents that surf the main gun.
  • GunFormula and AntiSurferFormula: their feature spaces, which also fix the layout of a gun seed sample.

Each view's seeded neighbours count at the seed's weight, and faded seeds stop counting as data (RES-4); every view is bounded (RES-2); the k share follows the tick budget (TIME-1, TIME-2). The gun sees no clock and no randomness, so the same waves give the same aim (CORE-2).

Dependencies: this package uses the model, physics and knn packages and the JDK (CORE-1). The architecture tests forbid it to depend on move (gun and movement are independent), memory, adapt, policy, melee or posture: the core applies the opening book's and the tick budget's decisions through this package's setters. It is one of the duel packages DuelIdentityTest pins.
